---
name: Counter-example
about: A pattern that does not hold in your practice
title: "Counter-example: <pattern name>"
labels: counter-example
---

**Which pattern**, by name and number — e.g. *Honest Gauge (OM-001, 12)*.

**What it claims** that your practice contradicts. Quote the line if you can.

**What you saw instead.** Enough for someone else to recognise the situation:
what the setup was, what the pattern predicted, what actually happened.

**How often.** Once is a result. Repeatedly is a stronger one. Say which.

A pattern shown not to hold somewhere else is a useful result and will be
recorded as one, with credit.
